Claim 1 (Currently amended): A method, comprising: inputting database constructs generated by a database optimizer as an input to a trained machine-learning algorithm; obtaining a database operation predictor from the machine-learning algorithm as an output; modifying at least one of the database constructs based on the database operation predictor producing a modified database construct; and processing a database operation with the database constructs and the modified database construct, wherein the database operation is executed based on a modified query execution plan.

Claim 10 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 further comprising, storing the database operation predictor in database statistics associated with the database operation and the database constructs, wherein the database statistics include performance metrics for the database operation.

Claim 12 (Currently amended): A method comprising: training a machine-learning algorithm with database constructs produced by a database optimizer; receiving query execution plans for a query from the database optimizer with a least cost query execution plan identified by the database optimizer for the query; providing the query execution plans as input to the machine-learning algorithm; obtaining as an output a predicted execution time for the query based on the least cost query execution plan; and modifying one of: the least cost query execution plan for the query, a scheduled execution time for the query, and resources that are used to execute the query based on the predicted execution time, wherein the modification is based on performance data associated with historical executions of the least cost query execution plan.

Claim 19 (Currently amended): A system, comprising: a database management system; at least one hardware processor; a non-transitory computer-readable storage medium having executable instructions representing a trained machine-learning algorithm; the machine learning algorithm configured to execute on the at least one hardware processor from the non-transitory computer-readable storage medium and to perform processing to: i) receive as input database constructs produced by a database optimizer for a database operation of the database management system; and ii) provide as output a predicted value relevant to one of: one or more of the database constructs and the database operation, wherein the predicted value includes an estimated execution time for a query execution plan for the query within the database management system.
